scope: RPG.GameCore.Retarget with ModifierOwnerAdjoinEntity, fixed positive MaxNumber and one TaskList; no ByRandom/Predictate/filter fields
selected_model: Resolve ModifierOwnerAdjoinEntity with TARGET-001 stable formation ordering, take its fixed MaxNumber ordered prefix, and execute the compiled TaskList once per selected target with ParamEntity rebound to exactly that target.
state_writes: only state writes produced by fully executable TaskList children
ordering_constraints: target collection is resolved before children
each target child scope completes before the next target begins
dsh_implementation_contract: Implement Retarget as a scoped child-task iterator, not as a global target mutation. Preserve target order and bind each selected child scope's ParamEntity explicitly. Reject every unselected payload form rather than choosing a random/filter policy.
